note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(艺术主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: In many old towns of China, a few skilled workers still make porcelain entirely by hand. Right now, in one small workshop, blue dragons are being painted onto white bowls, while finished pieces are being carried gently to a hot oven. Visitors from all over the world come to watch, amazed that such patient work still survives today.

questions.q: What are the workers in the workshop doing right now?
options: Decorating bowls and getting them ready for the oven.
Selling finished bowls to foreign tourists.
Cleaning the floor of the empty workshop.
Teaching the visitors how to paint at home.
questions.explanation: 原文说蓝龙正被画到白碗上、做好的瓷器被送进热炉,即装饰碗并准备烧制;其余与原文不符。

options: Because the bowls are made quickly by machines.
Because such careful handwork has lasted to this day.
Because the bowls are painted only in red.
Because the workshop is the largest in the world.
questions.explanation: 末句说游客惊讶于这种耐心的手工活至今仍存,即如此细致的手工保留至今。
